name: Dremio
description: This Test Connection validates the access to Dremio (Software or Cloud) through its Arrow Flight SQL interface and basic metadata extraction of namespaces, folders, and tables.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can reach Dremio and authenticate with the given credentials (username and password for Dremio Software, Personal Access Token for Dremio Cloud).
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to Dremio. Please validate the host and the credentials: for Dremio Software the REST URL, username and password, for Dremio Cloud the region and the Personal Access Token (PAT).

steps.name: GetDatabases
steps.description: List all the namespaces (sources/spaces) available in Dremio. Namespaces are mapped as databases in OpenMetadata.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch namespaces from Dremio. Please validate if the user has enough privileges to read catalog metadata.

steps.name: GetSchemas
steps.description: List all the folders within a namespace. Folders are mapped as schemas in OpenMetadata.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch folders from Dremio. Please validate if the user has enough privileges to read folder metadata.

steps.name: GetTables
steps.description: From a given folder, list the tables and views. If no folder is specified, we'll list from a random folder.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch tables/views from Dremio. Please validate if the user has enough privileges to read dataset metadata.

steps.name: GetQueries
steps.description: Check if we can access the job history (sys.jobs_recent in Dremio Software, sys.project.jobs_recent in Dremio Cloud) to get query logs. These queries are analyzed in the usage & lineage workflow.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read the job history from Dremio. Please validate that the user is allowed to read sys.jobs_recent (Dremio Software) or sys.project.jobs_recent (Dremio Cloud) for usage and lineage extraction.
